decision: Selected the site location that the Environment Agency's installations register publishes for permit EPR/LP3303PR (holder Equinix (UK) Limited, premises 'Slough Trading Estate, Equinix Slough Campus Data Centre', Buckingham Avenue, Slough, SL1 4AX): latitude 51.522148, longitude -0.629225 (grid reference SU9520081250), copied without transformation, as the campus locator of Equinix's Slough campus (LD4, LD5, LD6, LD7 and LD10). It is the regulator's single site point for the permitted combustion installation, not a building outline or surveyed position.

selected_properties.activities: Combustion; Any Fuel =>50MW - 1.1 A(1) a) (AR1); Directly Associated Activity (AR2, AR3)
selected_properties.premises: Slough Trading Estate, Equinix Slough Campus Data Centre
selected_properties.address: Slough Trading Estate, Equinix Slough Campus Data Centre, Equinix Slough Campus Data Centre, Buckingham Avenue, Slough, SL1 4AX

transform.note: No transform is applied to the published latitude and longitude. Check only: pyproj 3.7.1 EPSG:27700 -> EPSG:4326 of the register's easting and northing (495200, 181250) gives 51.5221538, -0.6292322, 0.82 m from the published point.

consistency_checks.permit_scope: The permit published at the register's documentURL (Permit.pdf, issued 26 February 2020 to Equinix (UK) Limited for 'Equinix Slough Campus Data Centre', Slough Trading Estate, Buckingham Avenue, SL1 4AX) covers 69 emergency standby generators in data centres LD4, LD5 (6 x 5.714 MWth and 8 x 5.200 MWth), LD6, LD7 and LD10, 331.084 MWth in total.
consistency_checks.site_plan: Schedule 7 of the permit (page 21) shows five separate green-edged installation plots on the trading estate: LD7, LD6 and LD4 to the west, LD5 south of the centre and LD10 to the east; the emission-points figure is captioned 'Slough Trading Estate, 8 Buckingham Ave, Slough SL1 4AX' and carries a 0-250 m scale bar, from which the plots span roughly 0.8 km east-west. The plan is not georeferenced, so the register point is not claimed to fall on any particular plot.
consistency_checks.nearby_records: The Atlas site Iron Mountain LON-3 London Data Center lies 0.67 km from the point; Iron Mountain LON-1 (724-729 Dundee Road, EA application EPR/LP3020MX/A001, SU 94926 81766; an Atlas hold, not a record) lies about 0.58 km north-west. Both are separate operators, addresses and permits.
consistency_checks.not_used: No commercial map, geocoder, postcode centroid, town centre or estate centroid is used.

scope_note: The point locates the five-plot Equinix Slough installation as a whole, not the LD5 building.
